text:
Ciara (CFO): Thanks for the great questions during today's all-hands — dropping clarifications here. TL;DR: burn is improving, runway is healthy for the plan we discussed, tightening a couple procurement gates, hiring is being prioritized but not frozen. Ask follow-ups below.

Priya (Finance): Quick numbers: net burn is roughly $1.3M/month after the infra optimizations landed. That gives us ~13 months of runway on current projections (plan includes conservative ARR growth). We track both cash runway and scenario runway in the finance dashboard.

Jason (GTM): @Ciara does ARR growth include the new enterprise pilot from last quarter or is that conservative?

Ciara (CFO): Good call — the 13 months is conservative and does NOT bake in the full pilot revenue. If pilot converts as expected, runway extends by ~3–5 months. We keep two views in the dashboard: base (conservative) and upside (includes expected closes).

Marco (Eng): For engineering: any immediate changes we should make to cloud billing tags or cost centers?

Priya (Finance): Yes — please add the label `cost_center` + `project` to all infra resources by end of month. Also tag any Dedicated/GPU pools with `dedicated:yes` so we can separate committed spend. Will push a short script in #eng-infra tomorrow to help.

Marco (Eng): thanks — would love the script. Also, for long-term Dedicated commitments, who signs off?

Ciara (CFO): For commitments > $50k/year, we need Finance + Eng leadership sign-off. For anything > $250k/year, COO approval required. Priya will share a short sign-off checklist.

Priya (Finance): Procurements: new approval matrix (effective today):
- spend <= $1k/year: manager approval
- $1k < spend <= $10k/year: manager + FP&A approval
- $10k < spend <= $50k/year: director + Finance
- spend > $50k/year: director + Finance + COO
Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/fin/procurement (policy + vendor onboarding form).

Jason (GTM): What about one-off vendor trials vs annual contracts?

Priya (Finance): Trials under 30 days and under $1k can be handled by the team. Anything longer or automated billing requires the vendor onboarding form + PO.

Lina (People Ops): On hiring: is there a hiring freeze or slowed hiring for FY? People Ops coordinating with Finance on prioritization — what signal should we use to greenlight new reqs?

Ciara (CFO): No company-wide freeze. We have a hiring prioritization scorecard: revenue-impact, customer-facing, critical infra, legal/compliance. Teams should submit reqs with a short justification and link to scorecard. We'll publish the Q2 scorecard next week and triage weekly.

Marco (Eng): Any expected changes to contractor vs full-time mix budget?

Ciara (CFO): We're favoring critical full-time hires for product/core infra, and using contractors for short-term surge work. Finance will share target FTE vs contractor split per org by next Friday.

ops-bot: Policy updated: procurement-policy.md v1.2 published by Priya (Finance).

Priya (Finance): Action items: 1) I'll share the sign-off checklist + vendor onboarding form (Priya). 2) Script for infra tagging (Priya + EngInfra). 3) Hiring scorecard published next week (People Ops). 4) Template for Dedicated commitment approvals (Finance + Eng).

Ciara (CFO): Thanks all — please ping me or Priya if you need an exception. If folks want a short live session on the procurement flow, LMK and we'll schedule a 30min walk-through. :thumbsup:
